description: This line plot illustrates how three metrics—“Initial Acc,” “Δ Acc,” and an unlabeled gray shaded region—vary with “Initial Confidence,” which is plotted on the x-axis ranging from 0.95 to 0.99 in linear scale with tick marks spaced every 0.01. The y-axis represents “Accuracy,” scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0. The “Initial Acc” metric is depicted by a green dashed line with diamond markers, starting at approximately 0.00 and rising steadily to about 0.14. The “Δ Acc” metric is shown by an orange dashed line with diamond markers, beginning at approximately 0.89 and decreasing slightly to about 0.75. The unlabeled gray shaded region, represented by a blue solid line with circle markers, starts at approximately 0.89, remains nearly flat near 0.90, and ends at approximately 0.86.
